author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 11 Worksheets, Quizzes, & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting across Grade 11 Basic (course-math-g11-basic: 7 chapters, 18 lessons, 73 points) and Advanced (course-math-g11-advanced: 8 chapters, 15 lessons, 59 points) worksheets, point quizzes, and question bank (zero raw slash fractions, standardized \dfrac, fixed \ldots and KaTeX math delimiters, converted currency signs to \text{ ដុល្លារ}); upgraded all 132 points with 3 distinct difficulty levels (កម្រិត ១: ស្រួល / មូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះ, កម្រិត ២: មធ្យម / ការយល់ដឹង និងអនុវត្ត, កម្រិត ៣: ពិបាក / គិតស៊ីជម្រៅ និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា) totaling 396 comprehensive exercises with step-by-step teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣); audited 33 point quiz lessons and 1395 question bank questions for zero math errors; verified 100% data integrity for all other grades (7, 8, 9, 10, 12).
